user.title: Home Inventory
user.description: Set up the household inventory. It appears as "Vorrat" in the sidebar. Stock, booking and expiry dates are always included; choose the other modules (can be changed later in the settings).

unit_is_default.message: This unit (or one defined on it) is the default unit. Change the default under Settings › Defaults first.

shopping_unknown.message: “{name}” is neither a product nor a category. Add new ones in the Home Inventory panel under Einkauf.

location_has_stock.message: The location still holds stock. Move or take it out first.

not_loaded.message: The home_inventory integration is not loaded.

in_use.message: The entry is still in use and cannot be deleted.

duplicate.message: An entry with this name already exists.

partial_one_package.message: A partly used package is always exactly 1 package at one location.

invalid_unit.message: Invalid unit: the factor must be greater than 0 and a base unit cannot have a base unit itself.

invalid_parent.message: A category cannot be moved into itself or one of its subcategories.

csv_rows.message: The file has more than {max} rows.

grocy_file.message: This is not a Grocy file (products, product_groups, locations, quantity_units, product_barcodes or stock as JSON).

grocy_products.message: The Grocy products file (products.json) is missing.

category_required.message: No category found for this product: enter one in the category column.

not_freezable.message: This product is not frozen at home (module Freezing off, not a food, bought frozen, or no days frozen set).

no_freezer.message: No freezer location: mark a location as freezer in the settings.

frozen.message: This package is frozen; thaw it first.

undo_blocked.message: “{name}” cannot be booked back: the stock has changed since.

url_private.message: Links into the local network can only be imported by an administrator.

recipe_unreachable.message: The page could not be loaded.

recipe_not_found.message: No recipe found on this page. Without schema.org recipe data an AI must be set up (options, AI).

off_unavailable.message: Open Food Facts is not reachable. Please try again later.

product_unknown.message: No product with barcode or name {code}. Book new products in once in the Home Inventory panel.

no_label_printer.message: No label printer is configured (Settings › Devices & services › Home Inventory › Configure).

no_receipt_printer.message: No receipt printer is configured (Settings › Devices & services › Home Inventory › Configure › Receipt printer).

nothing_to_print.message: The shopping list has no open items to print.

diet_reload_busy.message: Another reload from Open Food Facts is already running.

not_food.message: This category is not a food and cannot be a recipe ingredient.

dish_required.message: Give a recipe or a text.

ai_failed.message: The AI check failed. The recipe draft stays as imported.

nothing_planned.message: No recipe is planned for this meal on that day.

plan_empty.message: The meal plan has nothing planned in this period.

ai_import_failed.message: The AI could not read the recipe. Please try again, or paste the recipe text.

external_off.message: This external service is turned off in the integration options (External services).

ai_off.message: No AI is set up (integration options, AI).

ai_no_files.message: The AI set up does not accept images.

init.title: Settings
init.description: What do you want to set up?

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Choose the parts of the panel you use. Turned off modules hide their tab or buttons; their data is kept.

label.title: Label printer settings
label.description: Host, label size and printing for the chosen label printer.

data_description.label_printer_host: Network: address of the print server (port {port} if you give only the host). USB on the Home Assistant host: the device path, e.g. /dev/usb/lp0 (in Docker, pass it with devices:).
data_description.test_print: Sends one test label to the printer when you save.

data.prefill_expiry: Fill in the guessed expiry date

data_description.household_servings: Servings the household cooks by default.
data_description.prefill_expiry: When booking in, the date field already shows today + the shelf life of the category. Off: the field stays empty; an empty date is still guessed when saving.

receipt.title: Receipt printer
receipt.description: ESC/POS receipt printer for the shopping list. Leave the printer empty for none.

data.receipt_cut: Cut the paper at the end

data_description.receipt_printer: USB on the Home Assistant host: the device path, e.g. /dev/usb/lp0 (USB printer) or /dev/ttyUSB0 (USB-serial) (in Docker, pass it with devices:). Network printer: host or host:port (port 9100 if only the host is given).
data_description.receipt_baud: Only for a device path of a serial / USB-serial printer; ignored for network printers. Use the printer's setting (often 9600 or 115200).
data_description.test_print: Sends one short test receipt to the printer when you save.

external.title: External services
external.description: Everything here sends data out of Home Assistant. Each service can be turned off on its own; the README section Privacy lists what goes where. AI services also need the AI Task entity (step AI).

data.off_lookup: Look up products in Open Food Facts
data.ai_import: AI reads recipes (link without recipe data, text, photo)
data.ai_video: Load videos for the recipe import

data_description.off_lookup: An unknown barcode and the online search are sent to openfoodfacts.org. Off: new products are entered by hand.
data_description.off_images: Your browser loads the small product pictures from images.openfoodfacts.org; that server sees your IP address and which picture is requested. Off: no pictures.
data_description.recipe_images: Your browser loads the recipe picture from the website the recipe was imported from; that server sees your IP address and which picture is requested. Off: no recipe pictures.
data_description.recipe_url: Home Assistant loads the page of a pasted link (only on click).
data_description.ai_recipe_check: Each import sends the recipe, the food category tree and the units (about 10,000 tokens) to the AI.
data_description.ai_product_check: When booking in a new product from Open Food Facts, its data, the category tree and the units go to the AI.
data_description.ai_import: Sends the page text and preview image of a link without recipe data, pasted text or a photo to the AI.
data_description.ai_video: Downloads the video of an Instagram, TikTok or YouTube post (yt-dlp, installed on first use) and sends it to the AI. Many platforms forbid downloads in their terms of use.
data_description.receipt_import: The receipt text is recognized in the browser; only that text and your product list go to the AI, not the photo.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: An AI set up in Home Assistant (AI Task, e.g. Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude) reads recipes without recipe data (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, pasted text, photos) and checks every recipe import once: ingredient categories and steps. Leave empty for no AI. Assist agents and the MCP Server use the LLM API “Home Inventory” when you select it there; the access level decides what they may do.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Each import sends the recipe and the food category tree (about 10,000 tokens) to this AI; reading a post also sends its image, and its video when allowed under External services.
data_description.llm_access: Applies to every assistant that uses the LLM API “Home Inventory”.

book_in.name: Book in
book_in.description: Book packages of a known product in by its barcode. Returns batch_id (for print_labels).

code.name: Barcode
code.description: EAN or name of a product already in the home_inventory.

expires_on.name: Expiry date
expires_on.description: Best-before / use-by date; empty: today + shelf life (marked as guessed), no date without a shelf life.

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Name of the location; empty = the product's default location.

book_out.name: Book out
book_out.description: Take packages out by barcode (earliest expiry first) or by a scanned label code (PTRY:…, one package of that batch).

code.name: Code
code.description: EAN, label code PTRY:… or product name

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Only from this location (not with a label code).

open_package.name: Open a package
open_package.description: Mark one package as opened by barcode (earliest expiry first) or by a scanned label code (PTRY:…, a package of that batch). Its expiry date gets shorter by the shelf life after opening.

code.name: Code
code.description: EAN, label code PTRY:… or product name

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Only from this location (not with a label code).

freeze_package.name: Freeze a package
freeze_package.description: Freeze packages of a fresh product (not frozen goods) by barcode, name (earliest date first) or label code (that batch). They move to a freezer location and get the date today + days frozen (a guide value).

code.name: Code
code.description: EAN, label code PTRY:… or product name

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Only from this location (not with a label code).

to_location.name: Target location
to_location.description: Freezer location to put them in (default: the first freezer).

thaw_package.name: Thaw a package
thaw_package.description: Thaw frozen packages by barcode, name (earliest date first) or label code (that batch). They count as opened today and keep for the days after opening (1 day without).

code.name: Code
code.description: EAN, label code PTRY:… or product name

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Only from this freezer location (not with a label code).

to_location.name: Target location
to_location.description: Where they go (default: the product's storage location).

print_labels.name: Print labels
print_labels.description: Print labels of a batch on the label printer.

print_shopping_list.name: Print shopping list
print_shopping_list.description: Print the open shopping list items on the receipt printer.

shop_recipe.name: Recipe on the shopping list
shop_recipe.description: Put a recipe on the shopping list: its missing ingredients are shopped for. Again for a recipe already on it: its servings change.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Name of the recipe (not a canning recipe).

cooked.name: Book out what a recipe used
cooked.description: Book out the ingredients of a recipe as proposed in the panel (the product that expires first, whole packages; the remainder opens a package). Optional ingredients and unknown amounts are skipped. Everything or nothing is booked.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Name of the recipe (not a canning recipe).

plan_to_shopping_list.name: Shopping list from the meal plan
plan_to_shopping_list.description: Put the recipes planned in a date range on the shopping list (servings summed; free-text dishes are skipped). Ingredients already in stock are subtracted.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days including the first. Empty = 7.

plan_meal.name: Plan a dish
plan_meal.description: Add a dish to the meal plan: a recipe or free text.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Name of the recipe; or give a text instead.

text.name: Text
text.description: Free text instead of a recipe, e.g. “Pizza from the delivery service”.

canning.name: Canning protocol
canning.description: Record a canning run from a canning recipe: a new charge with its jars booked in. Returns batch_id (for printing labels) and charge.

recipe.name: Canning recipe
recipe.description: Name of the canning recipe; it sets product, temperature and minutes.

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Name of the location; empty = the product's default location.

drying.name: Drying protocol
drying.description: Record a drying run from a drying recipe: new charge, the packages are booked in. Returns batch_id (to print labels) and charge.

recipe.name: Drying recipe
recipe.description: Name of the drying recipe; it sets product, temperature and duration.

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Name of the location; empty = the product's default location.

store_leftovers.name: Store leftovers
store_leftovers.description: Store leftovers of a cooked dish as a new charge (one package per serving, best before = made-on date + 3 days unless frozen). Returns id, batch_id (to print labels), charge, name and expires_on.

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Name of the location; empty = the default location of the leftovers.

print_recipe.name: Print recipe
print_recipe.description: Print a recipe on the receipt printer: ingredients (scaled to the servings) and numbered steps.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: Name of the recipe (also a canning recipe).

print_planned.name: Print planned recipe
print_planned.description: Print the recipes planned in the meal plan for a meal on the receipt printer, with the planned servings.

meal.name: Meal
meal.description: Empty = the current meal by the start times in the panel settings (Mahlzeiten).

print_plan.name: Print meal plan
print_plan.description: Print the meal plan of a day or a week (Monday to Sunday) on the receipt printer.

day.name: Day
day.description: Empty = today; for a week: any day of it.

options.read: Read only (stock, expiring, recipes, shopping list, meal plan)
options.plan: Read, shopping list and meal plan
options.all: Everything, including booking in and out and opening packages

options.browser: No printer - print via the browser
options.dymo_lw4xx: Dymo LabelWriter 450 / 4xx (network via a USB print server, port 9100, or USB)
